items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I met him in England when the band used to come.

ctx.x: around, all over the place. And every night we’d walk in and see everybody, and they’d say, “Oh you guys are here again.” You know they couldn’t figure out why we were at the concerts all the time. But it was such — Duke Ellington, that was such a thing, to go and watch that band and see all those people that were in the band.
They had the whole — that was the prime: Hodges and Harry—
Harry and Paul and Jimmy Hamilton. It was amazing.
